conviction_note: Findings sum to +2.5. I emit +2.0 because about 2 of the last 8 releases landed at or after the close (2024), which would leave the window empty, and because the renewables tape was weak into the seal (Iberian-exception headlines, -3.7% on 09-23). The evidence is a reaction pattern plus positioning, not a document showing the number beats, so the sizes stay capped even though this name's own print-day moves (median |D| ~5%, last five +4.3 to +15.7) are larger.
bar: Q2 2026 EBITDA ~92m EUR, net profit ~55m EUR and revenue ~100m EUR (Banco Sabadell preview, 17 Sep 2026: https://www.bolsamania.com/noticias/empresas/sabadell-pone-bajo-revision-precio-solaria-ve-dificil-cumpla-meta-2026--23601040.html). That implies H1 at about 205m EBITDA and about 135m net profit on top of Q1's 113.2m / 80.4m (https://solariaenergia.com/en/solaria-sees-profits-soar-by-50-in-the-first-quarter-and-accelerates-its-growth-in-digital-infrastructure-and-energy/). A Benzinga preview (snippet_only, the page returns 403) puts consensus H1 net profit at 128m, roughly agreeing, but gives H1 revenue at 160m, which disagrees with Sabadell. The company's FY2026 EBITDA target is ~330m, reiterated at Q1 (https://quartr.com/events/solaria-energ-a-y-medio-ambiente-s-a-slr-q1-2026_oSpXaNRV). Only one of the two estimate sources could be read in full, so the sizes are capped small.
session_check: Treated as in-session (bmo-equivalent), so the baseline window close 2026-09-23 -> close 2026-09-24 is correct. The event is confirmed by the issuer's CNMV OIR no. 42666 of 09/09/2026 13:24 ('Solaria comunica que publicará los resultados correspondientes al primer semestre del año 2026 el próximo jueves 24 de septiembre', https://www.cnmv.es/portal/otra-informacion-relevante/resultado-oir?nif=A83511501&lang=es) and by the issuer press note (https://solariaenergia.com/solaria-anunciara-sus-resultados-del-primer-semestre-de-2026-el-proximo-24-de-septiembre/, call at 18:00 CET). No release hour is announced. The CNMV timestamps of the last four results filings were all inside or before the session: Q1-26 18/05/2026 12:12, 9M-25 17/11/2025 08:23, H1-25 30/09/2025 09:27, Q1-25 03/06/2025 12:26. The 2024 ones came at 17:20 and 17:31. The analyst call at 18:00 CET falls after the close, so Q&A lands on D+1, outside this window.
positioning_check: The baseline's register is marked unreachable, but the CNMV per-issuer page DOES read from this container: https://www.cnmv.es/portal/consultas/ee/posicionescortas?nif=A83511501&lang=es, read 2026-09-23. It shows seven live positions of 0.5% or more, totalling 5.61% of capital. JPMorgan AM (UK) 1.33 (12/08), Marchant 1.00 (14/07), Marshall Wace 0.82 (21/09), Parvus 0.69 (19/08), AHL 0.68 (07/09), WorldQuant 0.59 (18/09), BlackRock Advisors 0.50 (15/09). On 12 Aug merca2 reported 5.1% across six holders (https://www.merca2.es/2026/08/12/solaria-posiciones-cortas-fondos-bajistas-2434929/), with Parvus at 1.02 and AHL at 0.90. So the aggregate is flat to slightly building, but the holders are rotating. The discretionary shorts are trimming (Parvus 1.02->0.69, AHL 0.90->0.68, CFM 0.81 no longer listed). Quant and multi-strategy books are adding in the last week (Marshall Wace new 0.82 on 21/09, WorldQuant 0.59 on 18/09). That is about 7.4m shares against roughly 1.1m shares a day of volume.

findings.finding: Solaria's print-day reaction is structurally skewed upward over this window. The sell-side has repeatedly under-modelled its non-generation income: Q1-26 net profit was 80.4m against a 17m consensus, with 49.6m of infrastructure services against 25.8m of energy sales. The release lands in-session with a growth headline, while the call where quality gets questioned comes at 18:00 CET after the close. The stock closed up on D at each of the last five prints (+9.44% on 2025-06-03, +5.27% on 2025-09-30, +15.72% on 2025-11-17, +8.73% on 2026-02-26, +4.31% on 2026-05-18). Against Sabadell's 92m Q2 EBITDA bar, I expect a modest beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: D-day closes computed from Yahoo daily bars, with CNMV filing times. The last five in-session prints were all up: +9.44, +5.27, +15.72, +8.73, +4.31. The two 2024 post-close prints fell on D+1 (-7.58 on the 9M-24 profit cut, +1.83). The largest beat (Q1-26, NP 80 vs 17 est.) was +4.31 on D and then -6.34 on D+1 after the call, so beats are sold on digestion and only D counts here.

findings.why_not_priced: Had the market priced a print-day pop, the stock would be running up into the release. Instead it is -1.9% over 20 days and -15.6% over 60, fell 3.7% on the seal day, is ~32% below its 26 May close of 24.47, and has disclosed shorts still at 5.6% with fresh quant shorts dated 18 and 21 September. The bar has already moved up after Q1: Sabadell's 92m Q2 EBITDA is +39% year on year. That leaves the edge thinner than in May, which is why the size is small.
findings.independence: Partly independent: the reaction series is my own computation from Yahoo bars (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/SLR.MC?range=3y&interval=1d) timed by CNMV filings (https://www.cnmv.es/portal/otra-informacion-relevante/resultado-oir?nif=A83511501&page=2&lang=es). Arithmetic check: 113.2m Q1 EBITDA + 92m Q2 = ~62% of the ~330m FY target at H1 (https://quartr.com/events/solaria-energ-a-y-medio-ambiente-s-a-slr-q1-2026_oSpXaNRV), so the release can frame the year as ahead of plan. The firm said it would only update guidance at an undated H2 investor day.

findings.finding: The disclosed short book is 5.61% across seven holders on the live CNMV register. It is rotating from discretionary to quant holders into the print: Marshall Wace opened 0.82% on 21/09 and WorldQuant 0.59% on 18/09, while Parvus cut 1.02%->0.69% and AHL 0.90%->0.68% since August. On a headline beat that is about 7 days of volume to cover.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean prior read on squeezes. The Nov-2025 print (+15.72% on D) came while the stock was already rallying. Shorts built through Jul-Aug 2026 as the stock fell 35% (merca2, 12 Aug).

findings.why_not_priced: The sealed baseline has no positioning at all (covered: false), so the stage's lean is just the run-up. The register is public, but the rotation (fundamental shorts trimming while quant books add in the last week) is only visible by diffing it against August press coverage. Had it been read as bearish conviction building, the stock would not have held 16-17.5 through September on flat volume.
findings.independence: Rests on a different document from finding 1. The August baseline comes from merca2 (https://www.merca2.es/2026/08/12/solaria-posiciones-cortas-fondos-bajistas-2434929/): 5.1%, Parvus 1.02, AHL 0.90, CFM 0.81. The amplification depends on finding 1's beat landing, so the two are correlated in outcome, not in evidence.

outside_window.finding: The government may bring back the 'excepción ibérica' gas cap as the current Plan de Respuesta expires on 30 Sep. It knocked Solaria -3.7% on 09-23, but Sabadell says the impact is limited because ~80% of its output is under PPA. Any decision will likely come at a Consejo de Ministros after the window, and it could reverse the move either way.

The H2 2026 London investor day, where management said it would update EBITDA guidance and the business plan, is still undated. The page announcing a 28 September CMD is from 2023 (it refers to H1 2023 results) and is not this year's.

searched_and_found_nothing: Información Privilegiada / guidance revision before the print: the CNMV IP listing (https://www.cnmv.es/portal/informacion-privilegiada/resultado-ip?nif=A83511501&lang=es) shows only the 29/04/2026 ABB pricing. No profit warning or guidance change was filed.

A new data-centre connection deal since the second Merlin agreement (Feb-2026): nothing in the OIR list through 09/09/2026. The last business OIRs are the IDAE grant (12/06), the La Spina 600 MW VIA in Italy (28/07) and the H1 date notice (09/09). Sabadell does not expect new connections either. Market-visible, so sized 0.

Q2 Spanish solar captured prices: industry series show April capture factor 0.28 against 0.30 a year earlier (https://pexapark.com/blog/european-solar-capture-factors-collapse-as-april-oversupply-triggers-wave-of-negative-prices/). Sabadell estimates Solaria's blended price at ~42 EUR/MWh, +2% yoy, with 80% under PPA. Priced industry proxy, not a company document.

Draft Royal Decree on data centres (80% hourly additional renewable coverage; hearing closed 10 Sep): the sign for Solaria is ambiguous and it cannot resolve in the window (https://www.miteco.gob.es/en/energia/participacion/2026/detalle-participacion-publica-k-851.html).
Q1-26 interim report PDF (https://solariaenergia.com/wp-content/uploads/IDG-Q1-2026.pdf): image-based, eu_pdftext.py returned no text.
Benzinga España previews (es.benzinga.com, two URLs): 403 to both curl and WebFetch, so their figures are snippet_only and not load-bearing.
baseline_tension: Orthogonal to the lean rather than agreeing with it. The lean is +0.096 (the run-up alone) and the free control is nearly flat at -1.9% over 20 days. My positive read rests on the reaction pattern and on short-book rotation. It cuts against the 60-day drawdown (-15.6%) and the weak renewables tape on the seal day.
language_note: The CNMV per-issuer pages (Spanish-language registry) carried everything decisive. They gave the exact filing times of past results releases, which settled the unresolved session; the confirmation of the 24-Sep date; and the live short register with holders and dates. None of this was in any English source, and the baseline had marked the register unreachable.

Sabadell's Q2 preview numbers (EBITDA ~92m, NP ~55m, blended price ~42 EUR/MWh, 80% PPA, production ~1,330 GWh) appeared only in Bolsamanía's Spanish copy. English search returned only the Q1 figures and generic forecasts.

The seal-day driver, the 'excepción ibérica' headlines behind the renewables sell-off on 23-Sep, appeared only in Spanish press. So did the per-fund history of the short build (merca2, 12-Aug) and the dated Q1 beat against consensus (Capitalbolsa).
lessons_applied: 'Understatement is the hunters' systematic error / size on the name's own reaction distribution': I raised finding 1 from +1.5 to +2.0 and widened its high to +9. This name's observed |D| median is ~5% against the baseline's cadence-estimated 3.21 lower bound. I kept it capped because the bar rests on one fully read estimate source.
'Positioning is the thing to beat... a crowded short is fuel': confirmed that finding 2 should stay positive rather than read the building quant shorts as bearish conviction. Size unchanged at +0.5.

'The session is the most load-bearing field': already settled from CNMV filing times before reading the file. The expected move moved from +1.5 to +2.0, still visibly below the +2.5 sum, to carry the ~20-25% risk of a post-close release that would empty the window.
